name: mGBA
location: Next to the ROM, or in mGBA's savegamePath
notes: Raw save, followed for games with a cartridge clock by the 16 bytes of struct GBASavedataRTCBuffer (mGBA src/gba/savedata.c, GBASavedataRTCWrite), written at the save size rounded down to 256 bytes: the footer is there when the file size modulo 256 is 16. It is removed on read and never written: mGBA adds it again, from the clock of the device.
